view: PA (frontal), L marker at patient's left shoulder confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration and penetration, minimal rotation, costophrenic angles included; left shoulder partly cut off at the image edge. Retrocardiac and hilar detail moderately limited by the soft image contrast.

devices.type: Left shoulder arthroplasty (metallic humeral head prosthesis with stem, hemiarthroplasty)
devices.location: left glenohumeral joint / left shoulder, upper image right corner
over left clavicle / left shoulder region, image upper right

abnormalities.finding: Rounded, slightly lobulated perihilar opacity at the right hilum (~3-4 cm) with an enlarged, dense right hilum compared with the left; consistent with the labelled right hilar/perihilar mass
Prominent, rounded aortic knob with a tortuous/unfolded thoracic aorta (age-related ectasia; aneurysm not excluded)
Mild widening of the superior mediastinum secondary to the unfolded aorta

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光：右側肺門區可見一約3–4公分、邊緣略呈分葉狀的圓形高密度陰影，右肺門較左側增大且密度增加，位於右肺中野內側，符合標註之右肺門／肺門旁腫塊。主動脈弓明顯突出且走向迂曲（老年性主動脈延長），上縱膈輕度增寬。雙側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，心臟大小約在正常上限。左肩可見金屬肱骨頭人工關節（左肩關節置換），左肩區另有L側別標記；未見胸管、引流管或其他已治療之證據。
